messages:
Alex: kicking off staged rollout to 5% now for rtx-service v2.3.2 (prebake window ended).
Sam: noted, I'll watch request QPS and tail latencies. ping me if 95p > 800ms for >5m.
DeployBot: deploy started: rtx-service:v2.3.2 -> traffic 5% (group: eu-west, na). job_id=deploy-8791
Maria: seeing a small increase in 99th on eu-west edge, ~1.1s for a few minutes. not widespread yet. :eyes:
Sam: can you paste the quick metrics snapshot?
Maria: sure — recent 10m:
```
region eu-west: p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 1120ms, errors 0.2%
region na: p50 90ms, p95 300ms, p99 430ms, errors 0.05%
kv-cache hit ~72% for this rollout
```
Alex: kv-cache drop on a subset maybe causing tail. if p99 stays >1s we should hold and pin back to v2.3.1-prev. ops-prep for rollback.
DeployBot: canary health checks: lat ok, error_rate within SLO, but tail_latency anomaly detected (eu-west p99 > 1s, alert id=lat-2034). recommended_action=HOLD
Oncall-Ryan: holding increase. do not bump to 10%. pin decision: yes if persists 10m. tagging infra to check kvcache eviction logs.
Sam: running quick scrape of eviction counts now.
Maria: eviction spikes aligned with traffic to a particular shard, looks like config mismatch on pool size for new model path.
Alex: ops, please open rollback-ready checklist. if we pin we should also update release notes with known kv-config change and mitigation steps.
DeployBot: rollback_ready checklist: 1) prev image available: yes 2) db-migration: none 3) config revert script: ready 4) traffic-shift job: queued
Sam: ETA for fix or revert? if we can patch config in 10-15m we might resume without full rollback.
Oncall-Ryan: agree. patch config on canary only, monitor 5m. if p99 drops <700ms and stable for 5m then proceed to 10%.
Maria: applying config patch to canary shard A now -> command: kubectl set env deployment/rtx-service CANARY_POOL=64 -n prod-eu
DeployBot: command accepted, patch job id=patch-332, rolling restart started for canary pods (eu-west shard A)
Maria: patch live. seeing p99 dropping to ~650ms after two minutes.
Sam: looks good. maintain at 5% for 5 more minutes and re-evaluate.
Alex: thanks all. keep this thread for go/no-go. if it regresses we pin and rollback immediately.
DeployBot: deploybot note: next scheduled autoscale cooldown at +12m. monitor.
Oncall-Ryan: marking HOLD -> PROCEED conditional: proceed to 10% after 5m stable with p99 < 800ms and no error spikes. I'll approve then.
Sam: will monitor and report at +5m.
Maria: final check at +5m: p99 eu-west 610ms, errors steady at 0.06%.
Sam: +5m stable. Oncall-Ryan, please confirm go.
Oncall-Ryan: GO to 10%. deploybot, initiate traffic bump to 10% for rtx-service:v2.3.2.
DeployBot: traffic shift initiated -> 10% target. job_id=deploy-8791-step2. will post results in this thread.
Alex: update release notes with kv-cache behavior and note that we paused at 5% initially due to tail latency and applied canary-only config fix. add rollback steps.
Maria: updated release_notes.md snippet: "Fix: adjusted CANARY_POOL default to avoid kvcache evictions observed in eu-west. Rollback: revert to v2.3.1-prev via deploybot rollback command."
Sam: thanks — keeping an eye on metrics. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: step2 complete: 10% live. summary: p95 380ms, p99 660ms, errors 0.07%. no new alerts.
Alex: closing hold thread. great coordination."
